fields.name: anchor_enabled
fields.label: Anchor Curve
fields._doc:
Anchor-based non-linear scale. "Pin THIS data value to
THIS position on the bar" - splits the range into two
linear segments. e.g. coolant 0-110, anchor=90,
position=50 makes 0-90 cover the first half, 90-110
cover the second half. anchor_enabled=false (default)
= pure linear.
fields.help: Pin a chosen reading to a fixed spot on the bar instead of filling from the end. e.g. put your normal operating temperature in the middle, so anything hotter or colder is obvious at a glance.

fields.name: anchor_value
fields.label: Anchor Value
fields.help: The reading you want pinned in place - e.g. 90 for your normal coolant temp.

fields.name: anchor_position
fields.label: Anchor Position (%)
fields.help: Where that reading sits along the bar (50 = middle, 0 = start, 100 = end).

fields.name: show_bar_value
fields.label: Show Value
fields.help: Show the number on the bar.

fields.name: smoothing_ms
fields.label: Smoothing (ms)
fields.help: Smooths out jumpy readings. Higher is smoother but slower to react; 0 shows the raw value.

fields.name: invert_bar_value
fields.label: Invert Fill
fields.help: Flip it so a high reading empties the bar instead of filling it.

fields.name: center_fill
fields.label: Center Fill (±)
fields.help: Fill out from the middle of the bar in both directions.

fields.name: fill_dir
fields.label: Fill Direction

fields.name: bar_in_range_color

fields.name: bar_image_full
fields.label: Fill Image
fields.help: Use a picture for the filled part instead of a plain colour.

fields.name: fill_edge_width
fields.label: Leading Edge Width
fields.help: How wide the bright tip at the current reading is (0 = off).

fields.name: fill_edge_color
fields.label: Leading Edge Color
fields.help: Colour of the bright tip that sits at the current reading.

fields.name: indicator_radius

fields.name: tick_count

fields.name: label_font

fields.name: label_text_align
fields.label: Text Align
fields.help: Line the text up left, centre or right.

fields.name: flash_mode
fields.label: Alert Type
fields.help: Stay lit while the signal is on, or flash on and off.

fields.name: flash_speed
fields.label: Flash Speed (ms)
fields.help: How fast it flashes (smaller = faster), in milliseconds.

fields.name: is_momentary
fields.label: Momentary

fields.name: font

fields.name: text_color

fields.name: rotation

fields.name: min
fields.label: Min Value
fields.help: The reading at the start of the dial.

fields.name: max
fields.label: Max Value
fields.help: The reading at the end of the dial.

fields.name: start_angle_user
fields.label: Start Angle (°)
fields._doc:
User-coord start angle: 0° = 12 o'clock, CW positive.
_meterSyncDerived translates this into the LVGL
start_angle/end_angle pair the firmware reads.
fields.help: Where the dial starts, as a clock position in degrees (0 = 3 o'clock, going clockwise).

fields.name: sweep_degrees
fields.label: Sweep
fields.help: How far around the dial goes. 270 is a normal gauge; 360 is a full circle.

fields.name: reverse
fields.label: Reverse Direction
fields.help: Run the dial backwards, so the high reading sits at the start.

fields.name: anchor_enabled
fields.label: Anchor Curve
fields._doc:
Anchor-based non-linear scale. "Pin THIS data value
to THIS position on the sweep" - splits the range into
two linear segments. e.g. anchor=90, position=50 makes
0-90 cover the first half of the sweep, 90-max the
second half. anchor_enabled=false (default) = linear.
fields.help: Pin a chosen reading to a fixed spot on the dial instead of sweeping from the start. e.g. put your normal operating temperature at the middle, so the needle rests centre when warmed up and swings high or low if it drifts.

fields.name: anchor_value
fields.label: Anchor Value
fields.help: The reading you want pinned in place - e.g. 90 for your normal coolant temp.

fields.name: anchor_position
fields.label: Anchor Position (%)
fields.help: Where that reading sits along the dial (50 = middle, 0 = start, 100 = end).

fields.name: show_ticks
fields.label: Show Ticks
fields.help: Show the marks around the dial, like the lines on a speedometer.

fields.name: major_tick_step
fields.label: Major Tick Value Spacing
fields.help: How far apart the biggest marks are, in reading value. On a 0-8000 rev counter, 1000 puts a big mark every 1000 RPM.

fields.name: mid_tick_step
fields.label: Medium Tick Value Spacing
fields._doc:
Optional 3rd tick tier between minor and major. Value spacing
in data units (e.g. 500 = a medium tick every 500 RPM). 0 = off.
fields.help: How far apart the medium marks are. 0 turns them off.

fields.name: minor_tick_step
fields.label: Minor Tick Value Spacing
fields._doc:
auto_ticks lives in w.config but is NOT in the inspector
- see _meterSyncDerived. Min/Major Tick Spacing replace
the old count-based fields.
fields.help: How far apart the smallest marks are. 0 turns them off.

fields.name: major_tick_width
fields.label: Major Tick Width
fields.help: How thick the biggest marks are.

fields.name: mid_tick_width
fields.label: Medium Tick Width
fields.help: How thick the medium marks are (0 = off).

fields.name: minor_tick_width
fields.label: Minor Tick Width
fields.help: How thick the smallest marks are.

fields.name: major_tick_length
fields.label: Major Tick Length
fields.help: How long the biggest marks are.

fields.name: mid_tick_length
fields.label: Medium Tick Length
fields.help: How long the medium marks are (0 = off).

fields.name: minor_tick_length
fields.label: Minor Tick Length
fields.help: How long the smallest marks are.

fields.name: major_tick_color
fields.label: Major Tick Color
fields.help: Colour of the biggest marks.

fields.name: mid_tick_color
fields.label: Medium Tick Color
fields.help: Colour of the medium marks.

fields.name: minor_tick_color
fields.label: Minor Tick Color
fields.help: Colour of the smallest marks.

fields.name: major_tick_image_name
fields.label: Major Tick Image
fields.help: Use a picture for each major (numbered) tick instead of a drawn line. Design it pointing up (tip toward the rim); it's rotated to each tick.

fields.name: mid_tick_image_name
fields.label: Medium Tick Image
fields.help: Use a picture for each medium tick instead of a drawn line. Design it pointing up (tip toward the rim).

fields.name: minor_tick_image_name
fields.label: Minor Tick Image
fields.help: Use a picture for each minor tick instead of a drawn line. Design it pointing up (tip toward the rim).

fields.name: tick_image_scale
fields.label: Tick Image Scale %
fields.help: Scale the tick images up or down (100 = original size). Applies to all three tick images.

fields.name: tick_outline_strength
fields.label: Tick Outline
fields.help: Draw an outline/glow behind the drawn ticks so they pop (0 = off, 255 = solid). No image needed.

fields.name: tick_outline_color
fields.label: Tick Outline Color
fields.help: Colour of the tick outline/glow (usually black for a crisp edge).

fields.name: tick_outline_fade
fields.label: Tick Outline Fade
fields.help: Soften the outline into a glow (0 = hard edge, higher = wider soft glow).

fields.name: show_tick_labels
fields.label: Show Tick Labels
fields.help: Show numbers next to the biggest marks.

fields.name: tick_label_font
fields.label: Tick Label Font
fields.help: Text style and size of those numbers.

fields.name: tick_label_color
fields.label: Tick Label Color
fields.help: Colour of those numbers.

fields.name: label_gap
fields.label: Label Gap
fields.help: How far the numbers sit from the marks.

fields.name: tick_label_divisor
fields.label: Tick Label Divisor
fields._doc:
Divides each tick label by this factor — e.g. 1000 turns a
0..7000 tach into 0..7 (print the unit elsewhere, "RPM x1000").
fields.help: Shrink the numbers by dividing them. Set 1000 and a 7000 mark just shows '7' - common on rev counters.

fields.name: redline_enabled
fields.label: Redline
fields._doc:
Redline zone: visual cues drawn between threshold and
max. Show Arc + Recolor Ticks default ON so enabling
the master toggle gives an immediate visible result.
fields.help: Show a warning zone, like a rev counter's red zone.

fields.name: redline_threshold
fields.label: Redline Threshold
fields.help: The reading where the warning zone starts.

fields.name: redline_color
fields.label: Redline Color
fields.help: Colour of the warning zone.

fields.name: redline_show_arc
fields.label: Show Arc
fields.help: Draw a coloured band along the warning zone.

fields.name: redline_arc_width
fields.label: Arc Width
fields.help: How thick that band is.

fields.name: redline_arc_r_mod
fields.label: Arc Inset
fields.help: Move the warning band in or out from the dial.

fields.name: redline_recolor_ticks
fields.label: Recolor Ticks
fields.help: Turn the marks inside the warning zone that colour too.

fields.name: smoothing_ms
fields.label: Smoothing (ms)
fields.help: Smooths out jumpy readings. Higher is smoother but slower to react; 0 shows the raw value.

fields.name: meter_bg_color
fields.label: Background Color
fields.help: Background colour of the gauge face.

fields.name: meter_bg_opa
fields.label: Background Opacity
fields.help: How solid the gauge face is (0 = see-through, 255 = solid).

fields.name: bg_image_name
fields.label: Background Image
fields.help: Use a picture as the gauge face.

fields.name: border_color
fields.label: Border Color
fields.help: Colour of the outline around the gauge.

fields.name: border_width
fields.label: Border Width
fields.help: Thickness of the outline (0 = none).

fields.name: border_opa
fields.label: Border Opacity
fields.help: How solid the outline is (0-255).

fields.name: scale_padding
fields.label: Scale Padding
fields.help: Move the marks inward from the edge of the gauge.

fields.name: show_needle
fields.label: Show Needle
fields._doc:
Master toggle for the value needle. When off, the meter
renders ticks / labels / ball only — no needle line, image,
or needle shadow. Independent of Show Needle Ball.
fields.help: Show the pointer needle.

fields.name: needle_width
fields.label: Needle Width
fields.help: How thick the needle is.

fields.name: needle_color
fields.label: Needle Color
fields.help: Colour of the needle.

fields.name: needle_r_mod
fields.label: Needle Length Trim
fields.help: Shorten the needle from its outer end.

fields.name: needle_rear_length
fields.label: Needle Rear Length
fields.help: How far the needle sticks out behind its centre, for a counterweight look.

fields.name: needle_inner_radius
fields.label: Needle Start Radius
fields.help: Start the needle away from the centre, leaving a gap in the middle.

fields.name: needle_tip_style
fields.label: Needle Tip Style
fields.help: The shape of the needle's tip.

fields.name: needle_tip_base_w
fields.label: Tip Base Width
fields._doc:
Tip-tuning knobs. Stored value 0 = "use the built-in
default for the current style". `autoFn` returns the
resolved default the firmware would pick - mirrors the
same defaults used in widget_meter.c's DRAW_PART hook
so the inspector can show the effective number even
when the user hasn't entered an explicit override.
fields.help: How wide the needle is at its base (leave at auto unless you want to set it).

fields.name: needle_tip_point_w
fields.label: Tip Point Width
fields.help: How wide the needle is at its tip.

fields.name: needle_tip_taper
fields.label: Tip Taper %
fields.help: How sharply the needle narrows toward the tip.

fields.name: needle_image_name
fields.label: Needle Image
fields.help: Use a picture as the needle instead of a drawn one.

fields.name: needle_pivot_x
fields.label: Needle Pivot X
fields.help: Move the needle's centre point left or right.

fields.name: needle_pivot_y
fields.label: Needle Pivot Y
fields.help: Move the needle's centre point up or down.

fields.name: needle_angle_offset
fields.label: Needle Angle Offset
fields.help: Rotate where the needle rests, in degrees.

fields.name: show_needle_ball
fields.label: Show Needle Ball
fields._doc:
Toggle the center pivot ball. When off, the ball is hidden
regardless of size. Independent of Show Needle.
fields.help: Show a round hub in the middle of the needle.

fields.name: needle_ball_size
fields.label: Needle Ball Size
fields.help: How big the hub is.

fields.name: needle_ball_color
fields.label: Needle Ball Color
fields.help: Colour of the hub.

fields.name: image_name
fields.label: Image
fields.help: The picture to show.

fields.name: image_scale
fields.label: Scale %
fields.help: Resize the picture, as a percentage.

fields.name: opacity
fields.label: Opacity (0-255)
fields.help: How see-through the picture is (0 = invisible, 255 = solid).

fields.name: recolor
fields.label: Color Overlay
fields.help: Tint the whole picture this colour.

fields.name: recolor_opa
fields.label: Overlay Strength (0-255)
fields.help: How strong the tint is (0 = none, 255 = full). Tinting a light icon white can make it disappear.

fields.name: shape_type
fields.label: Shape
fields.help: The shape to draw.

fields.name: bg_color
fields.label: Background
fields.help: Fill colour.

fields.name: bg_opa
fields.label: Opacity (0-255)
fields.help: How see-through the fill is (0 = invisible, 255 = solid).

fields.name: border_color
fields.label: Border Color
fields.help: Colour of the outline.

fields.name: border_width
fields.label: Border Width
fields.help: Thickness of the outline (0 = none).

fields.name: border_radius
fields.label: Border Radius
fields.help: How rounded the corners are (for rectangles).

fields.name: shadow_width
fields.label: Shadow Width
fields.help: How far the drop shadow spreads (0 = no shadow).

fields.name: shadow_color
fields.label: Shadow Color
fields.help: Colour of the shadow.

fields.name: shadow_opa
fields.label: Shadow Opacity
fields.help: How dark the shadow is (0-255).

fields.name: shadow_ofs_x
fields.label: Shadow X
fields.help: Move the shadow left or right.

fields.name: shadow_ofs_y
fields.label: Shadow Y
fields.help: Move the shadow up or down.

fields.name: bake_into_gauge
fields.label: Bake Into Gauge (perf)
fields.help: Lock this shape into the background so it draws faster. It won't change while driving - use for decoration only.

fields.name: orientation
fields.label: Orientation
fields.help: Which way the line runs (across, up-down, or diagonal).

fields.name: line_color
fields.label: Color
fields.help: Colour of the line.

fields.name: line_width
fields.label: Thickness
fields.help: How thick the line is.

fields.name: line_opa
fields.label: Opacity (0-255)
fields.help: How see-through the line is (0-255).

fields.name: rounded
fields.label: Rounded Ends
fields.help: Round the line's ends.

fields.name: dash_gap
fields.label: Dash Gap (0 = solid)
fields.help: Gap between dashes (0 = a solid line).

fields.name: op
fields.label: Operator
fields.help: How the reading is checked to pop up the message (over, under, equal to, or within a range).

fields.name: threshold
fields.label: Threshold
fields.help: The value the reading is checked against.

fields.name: range_min
fields.label: Range Min
fields.help: The bottom of the range (when using 'within a range').

fields.name: range_max
fields.label: Range Max
fields.help: The top of the range (when using 'within a range').

fields.name: text
fields.label: Message
fields.help: The message to show when it pops up.

fields.name: text_align
fields.label: Text Align
fields.help: Line the message up left, centre or right.

fields.name: bg_color
fields.label: Background
fields.help: Background colour.

fields.name: bg_opa
fields.label: Opacity
fields.help: How solid the background is (0-255).

fields.name: text_color
fields.label: Text Color
fields.help: Colour of the message.

fields.name: font
fields.label: Font
fields.help: Text style and size.

fields.name: border_width
fields.label: Border Width
fields.help: Thickness of the outline (0 = none).

fields.name: border_color
fields.label: Border Color
fields.help: Colour of the outline.

fields.name: radius
fields.label: Corner Radius
fields.help: How rounded the corners are.

fields.name: start_angle_user
fields.label: Start Angle (°)
fields.help: Where the gauge starts, as a clock position in degrees (0 = 3 o'clock, going clockwise). This is the empty end.

fields.name: sweep_degrees
fields.label: Sweep (°)
fields.help: How far around the circle the gauge goes. 270 covers most of a circle like a normal gauge; 360 is a full circle.

fields.name: signal_min
fields.label: Signal Min
fields.help: The reading that shows the gauge empty (the start).

fields.name: signal_max
fields.label: Signal Max
fields.help: The reading that shows the gauge full (the end).

fields.name: tick_min
fields.label: Tick Start Value
fields.help: The first number the marks count from. Usually the same as the empty value.

fields.name: tick_max
fields.label: Tick End Value
fields.help: The last number the marks count up to. Usually the same as the full value.

fields.name: anchor_enabled
fields.label: Anchor Curve
fields._doc:
Anchor-based non-linear scale. "Pin THIS data value to
THIS position on the bar" - splits the range into two
linear segments. e.g. coolant 0-110, anchor=90,
position=50 makes 0-90 cover the first half, 90-110
cover the second half. anchor_enabled=false (default)
= pure linear.
fields.help: Pin a chosen reading to a fixed spot on the gauge instead of filling from the empty end. e.g. put your normal operating temperature in the middle, so the gauge sits centre when warmed up and clearly runs high or low if it drifts.

fields.name: anchor_value
fields.label: Anchor Value
fields.help: The reading you want pinned in place - e.g. 90 for your normal coolant temp.

fields.name: anchor_position
fields.label: Anchor Position (%)
fields.help: Where that reading sits along the gauge (50 = middle, 0 = start, 100 = end).

fields.name: reverse
fields.label: Reverse Direction
fields.help: Run the gauge backwards, so the full end becomes the empty end.

fields.name: smoothing_ms
fields.label: Smoothing (ms)
fields.help: Smooths out jumpy readings. Higher is smoother but slower to react; 0 shows the raw, instant value.

fields.name: arc_width
fields.label: Arc Width
fields.help: How thick the coloured (filled) part of the gauge is.

fields.name: arc_offset
fields.label: Arc Offset
fields.help: Moves the ring in or out from the centre. Use it to stack one gauge inside another.

fields.name: arc_color
fields.label: Arc Color
fields.help: Colour of the filled part.

fields.name: grad_stops
fields.label: Gradient
fields.help: Blend the arc through multiple colours as the reading climbs. The redline and alert colours still override it.

fields.name: bg_arc_color
fields.label: Track Color
fields.help: Colour of the empty part behind the fill.

fields.name: bg_arc_width
fields.label: Track Width
fields.help: How thick the empty background ring is. Make it wider or narrower than the fill for a raised or recessed look.

fields.name: rounded_ends
fields.label: Rounded Ends
fields.help: Give the gauge rounded ends instead of flat-cut ones.

fields.name: fade_fill
fields.label: Fade Fill
fields.help: Fade the colour from dim to bright along the filled part, for a glowing look.

fields.name: lead_edge_enabled
fields.label: Leading Edge
fields.help: Add a bright tip that sits at the current reading, like the glowing end of a digital bar.

fields.name: lead_edge_color
fields.label: Leading Edge Color
fields.help: Colour of that bright tip.

fields.name: lead_edge_width
fields.label: Leading Edge Width
fields.help: How wide the bright tip is.

fields.name: arc_image
fields.label: Track Image
fields.help: Use a picture for the empty background instead of a plain colour.

fields.name: arc_image_full
fields.label: Fill Image
fields.help: Use a picture for the filled part instead of a plain colour. It's uncovered bit by bit as the reading rises.

fields.name: arc_image_opa
fields.label: Track Image Opacity
fields.help: How solid the track image is (255 = fully visible, 0 = invisible).

fields.name: arc_image_recolor
fields.label: Track Image Tint
fields.help: Colour blended into the track image (turn up the tint strength to use it).

fields.name: arc_image_recolor_opa
fields.label: Track Tint Strength
fields.help: How strongly the tint colour is mixed into the track image (0 = off).

fields.name: arc_image_blend
fields.label: Track Image Blend
fields.help: How the track image is layered over what's behind it (Additive glows, Multiply darkens).

fields.name: arc_image_full_opa
fields.label: Fill Image Opacity
fields.help: How solid the fill image is (255 = fully visible, 0 = invisible).

fields.name: arc_image_full_recolor
fields.label: Fill Image Tint
fields.help: Colour blended into the fill image (turn up the tint strength to use it).

fields.name: arc_image_full_recolor_opa
fields.label: Fill Tint Strength
fields.help: How strongly the tint colour is mixed into the fill image (0 = off).

fields.name: arc_image_full_blend
fields.label: Fill Image Blend
fields.help: How the fill image is layered over what's behind it (Additive glows, Multiply darkens).

fields.name: arc_image_radial
fields.label: Radial Fill Reveal
fields.help: Uncover the fill image AROUND the ring (for round gauges) instead of sliding it in left-to-right. Use with a full ring fill image.

fields.name: redline_color
fields.label: Redline Color
fields.help: Colour of the warning zone (like a rev counter's red zone). Where it starts is set by this reading's high-warning level.

fields.name: redline_arc_width
fields.label: Redline Thickness
fields.help: How thick the warning-zone band is.

fields.name: redline_recolor_fill
fields.label: Redline Recolors Fill
fields.help: When the reading reaches the warning zone, turn the whole fill that colour - not just the band.

fields.name: show_ticks
fields.label: Show Ticks
fields.help: Show the marks around the gauge, like the lines on a speedometer.

fields.name: major_tick_step
fields.label: Major Tick Value Spacing
fields.help: How far apart the biggest marks are, in reading value. On a 0-8000 rev counter, 1000 puts a big mark every 1000 RPM.

fields.name: mid_tick_step
fields.label: Medium Tick Value Spacing
fields.help: How far apart the medium marks are. 0 turns them off.

fields.name: minor_tick_step
fields.label: Minor Tick Value Spacing
fields.help: How far apart the smallest marks are. 0 turns them off.

fields.name: major_tick_width
fields.label: Major Tick Width
fields.help: How thick the biggest marks are.

fields.name: mid_tick_width
fields.label: Medium Tick Width
fields.help: How thick the medium marks are.

fields.name: minor_tick_width
fields.label: Minor Tick Width
fields.help: How thick the smallest marks are.

fields.name: major_tick_length
fields.label: Major Tick Length
fields.help: How long the biggest marks are.

fields.name: mid_tick_length
fields.label: Medium Tick Length
fields.help: How long the medium marks are.

fields.name: minor_tick_length
fields.label: Minor Tick Length
fields.help: How long the smallest marks are.

fields.name: major_tick_color
fields.label: Major Tick Color
fields.help: Colour of the biggest marks.

fields.name: mid_tick_color
fields.label: Medium Tick Color
fields.help: Colour of the medium marks.

fields.name: minor_tick_color
fields.label: Minor Tick Color
fields.help: Colour of the smallest marks.

fields.name: major_tick_image_name
fields.label: Major Tick Image
fields.help: Use a picture for each major tick instead of a drawn line. Design it pointing up (tip toward the rim); it's rotated to each tick.

fields.name: mid_tick_image_name
fields.label: Medium Tick Image
fields.help: Use a picture for each medium tick instead of a drawn line. Design it pointing up (tip toward the rim).

fields.name: minor_tick_image_name
fields.label: Minor Tick Image
fields.help: Use a picture for each minor tick instead of a drawn line. Design it pointing up (tip toward the rim).

fields.name: major_tick_image_scale
fields.label: Major Tick Scale %
fields.help: Scale the major tick image (100 = original size).

fields.name: mid_tick_image_scale
fields.label: Medium Tick Scale %
fields.help: Scale the medium tick image (100 = original size).

fields.name: minor_tick_image_scale
fields.label: Minor Tick Scale %
fields.help: Scale the minor tick image (100 = original size).

fields.name: major_tick_image_opa
fields.label: Major Tick Opacity
fields.help: Fade the major tick image (255 = solid, 0 = invisible).

fields.name: mid_tick_image_opa
fields.label: Medium Tick Opacity
fields.help: Fade the medium tick image (255 = solid, 0 = invisible).

fields.name: minor_tick_image_opa
fields.label: Minor Tick Opacity
fields.help: Fade the minor tick image (255 = solid, 0 = invisible).

fields.name: major_tick_image_recolor
fields.label: Major Tick Tint
fields.help: Tint colour for the major tick image (set Tint Strength above 0 to apply).

fields.name: major_tick_image_recolor_opa
fields.label: Major Tick Tint Strength
fields.help: How strongly to tint the major tick image (0 = none, 255 = full tint colour).

fields.name: mid_tick_image_recolor
fields.label: Medium Tick Tint
fields.help: Tint colour for the medium tick image (set Tint Strength above 0 to apply).

fields.name: mid_tick_image_recolor_opa
fields.label: Medium Tick Tint Strength
fields.help: How strongly to tint the medium tick image (0 = none, 255 = full tint colour).

fields.name: minor_tick_image_recolor
fields.label: Minor Tick Tint
fields.help: Tint colour for the minor tick image (set Tint Strength above 0 to apply).

fields.name: minor_tick_image_recolor_opa
fields.label: Minor Tick Tint Strength
fields.help: How strongly to tint the minor tick image (0 = none, 255 = full tint colour).

fields.name: major_tick_image_offset
fields.label: Major Tick Position
fields.help: Move the major tick image inward (negative) or outward (positive), in pixels.

fields.name: mid_tick_image_offset
fields.label: Medium Tick Position
fields.help: Move the medium tick image inward (negative) or outward (positive), in pixels.

fields.name: minor_tick_image_offset
fields.label: Minor Tick Position
fields.help: Move the minor tick image inward (negative) or outward (positive), in pixels.

fields.name: tick_outline_strength
fields.label: Tick Outline
fields.help: Draw an outline/glow behind the drawn ticks so they pop (0 = off, 255 = solid). No image needed.

fields.name: tick_outline_color
fields.label: Tick Outline Color
fields.help: Colour of the tick outline/glow (usually black for a crisp edge).

fields.name: tick_outline_fade
fields.label: Tick Outline Fade
fields.help: Soften the outline into a glow (0 = hard edge, higher = wider soft glow).

fields.name: show_tick_labels
fields.label: Show Tick Labels
fields.help: Show numbers next to the biggest marks.

fields.name: tick_label_font
fields.label: Tick Label Font
fields.help: Text style and size of those numbers.

fields.name: tick_label_color
fields.label: Tick Label Color
fields.help: Colour of those numbers.

fields.name: label_gap
fields.label: Label Gap
fields.help: How far the numbers sit from the marks.

fields.name: tick_label_divisor
fields.label: Tick Label Divisor
fields.help: Shrink the numbers by dividing them. Set 1000 and a 7000 mark just shows '7' - common on rev counters.

fields.name: ticks_on_top
fields.label: Ticks On Top
fields.help: Draw the marks and numbers on top of the fill instead of behind it.

fields.name: arc_alerts_enabled
fields.label: Color Alerts
fields.help: Change the fill colour when the reading goes too low or too high (set the points below).

fields.name: arc_low
fields.label: Low Threshold
fields.help: At or below this reading, the fill turns the Low colour.

fields.name: arc_low_color
fields.label: Low Color
fields.help: Fill colour when the reading is low.

fields.name: arc_high
fields.label: High Threshold
fields.help: At or above this reading, the fill turns the High colour.

fields.name: arc_high_color
fields.label: High Color
fields.help: Fill colour when the reading is high.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Label
fields.help: Text shown on the switch.

fields.name: show_label
fields.label: Show Label
fields.help: Show the text.

fields.name: signal_on_threshold
fields.label: ON Threshold
fields.help: The reading at or above which the switch shows as ON.

fields.name: tx_can_id
fields.label: CAN ID
fields.help: Advanced: the CAN message ID this switch sends. Leave alone unless you're wiring it to the car's CAN bus.

fields.name: tx_bit_start
fields.label: Bit Start
fields.help: Advanced: which bit in the CAN message to set.

fields.name: tx_bit_length
fields.label: Bit Length
fields.help: Advanced: how many bits to send.

fields.name: tx_endian
fields.label: Endian
fields.help: Advanced: byte order of the sent value.

fields.name: tx_rate_hz
fields.label: TX Rate (Hz)
fields.help: Advanced: how often the message is resent while ON, per second, as a keepalive (0 = send once on change).

fields.name: remember_state
fields.label: Remember State
fields.help: Remember on/off across a reboot so a CAN-controlled output comes back the way you left it.

fields.name: image_name
fields.label: Image
fields.help: Icon shown on the switch.

fields.name: active_color
fields.label: Active Color
fields.help: Colour when ON.

fields.name: active_opa
fields.label: Active Opacity
fields.help: How solid it is when ON (0-255).

fields.name: inactive_color
fields.label: Inactive Color
fields.help: Colour when OFF.

fields.name: inactive_opa
fields.label: Inactive Opacity
fields.help: How solid it is when OFF (0-255).

fields.name: label_color
fields.label: Label Color
fields.help: Text colour.

fields.name: font
fields.label: Font
fields.help: Text style and size.

fields.name: label_align
fields.label: Text Align
fields.help: Line the text up left, centre or right.

fields.name: label_x
fields.label: Label X Offset
fields.help: Nudge the text left or right.

fields.name: label_y
fields.label: Label Y Offset
fields.help: Nudge the text up or down.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Label
fields.help: Text shown on the button.

fields.name: show_label
fields.label: Show Label
fields.help: Show the text.

fields.name: latch
fields.label: Latch (Toggle)
fields.help: Stay on after a press (toggle) instead of only while held. Momentary always sends OFF when you let go.

fields.name: remember_state
fields.label: Remember State
fields.help: Latch only: remember on/off across a reboot so the output comes back the way you left it.

fields.name: tx_can_id
fields.label: CAN ID
fields.help: Advanced: the CAN message ID this button sends. Leave alone unless wiring it to the car's CAN bus.

fields.name: tx_bit_start
fields.label: Bit Start
fields.help: Advanced: which bit in the CAN message to set.

fields.name: tx_bit_length
fields.label: Bit Length
fields.help: Advanced: how many bits to send.

fields.name: tx_endian
fields.label: Endian
fields.help: Advanced: byte order of the sent value.

fields.name: tx_rate_hz
fields.label: TX Rate (Hz)
fields.help: Advanced: how often the message is resent while held, per second, as a keepalive (0 = send once). A momentary always sends OFF on release regardless.

fields.name: bg_color
fields.label: Background
fields.help: Colour of the button.

fields.name: text_color
fields.label: Text Color
fields.help: Text colour.

fields.name: pressed_color
fields.label: Pressed Color
fields.help: Colour while you're pressing it.

fields.name: border_radius
fields.label: Border Radius
fields.help: How rounded the corners are.

fields.name: font
fields.label: Font
fields.help: Text style and size.

fields.name: label_align
fields.label: Text Align
fields.help: Line the text up left, centre or right.

fields.name: label_x
fields.label: Label X Offset
fields.help: Nudge the text left or right.

fields.name: label_y
fields.label: Label Y Offset
fields.help: Nudge the text up or down.

fields.name: image_name
fields.label: Image
fields.help: Icon shown on the button.

fields.name: signal_name
fields.label: Signal
fields.help: What drives the lights - usually RPM.

fields.name: range_min
fields.label: Range Min
fields.help: The reading where the first light comes on.

fields.name: range_max
fields.label: Range Max
fields.help: The reading where every light is on.

fields.name: led_count
fields.label: LED Count
fields.help: How many lights in the row.

fields.name: flash_threshold
fields.label: Flash RPM
fields.help: The reading where the whole row flashes - your shift point.

fields.name: flash_speed
fields.label: Flash Speed (ms)
fields.help: How fast it flashes (smaller = faster), in milliseconds.

fields.name: fill_mode
fields.label: Fill Direction
fields.help: How the lights fill up as the reading rises.

fields.name: color_low
fields.label: Low Color
fields.help: Colour of the first (low) lights.

fields.name: color_mid
fields.label: Mid Color
fields.help: Colour of the middle lights.

fields.name: color_high
fields.label: High Color
fields.help: Colour of the top lights.

fields.name: color_off
fields.label: Off Color
fields.help: Colour of lights that are off.

fields.name: threshold_mid
fields.label: Mid Threshold
fields.help: The reading where the lights switch to the middle colour.

fields.name: threshold_high
fields.label: High Threshold
fields.help: The reading where the lights switch to the top colour.

fields.name: led_spacing
fields.label: LED Spacing
fields.help: Gap between the lights.

fields.name: led_width
fields.label: LED Width (0=auto)
fields.help: How wide each light is (0 = fit automatically).

fields.name: led_height
fields.label: LED Height (0=auto)
fields.help: How tall each light is (0 = fit automatically).

fields.name: border_radius
fields.label: Corner Radius
fields.help: How rounded each light's corners are.

fields.name: min
fields.label: Min Value
fields.help: The reading at the start of the bar.

fields.name: max
fields.label: Max Value
fields.help: The reading at the end of the bar.

fields.name: redline
fields.label: Redline
fields.help: The reading where the warning zone starts along the bar.

fields.name: lit_color
fields.label: Fill Color
fields.help: Colour of the filled part.

fields.name: dim_color
fields.label: Track Color
fields.help: Colour of the empty part.

fields.name: dim_opa
fields.label: Track Opacity
fields.help: How see-through the empty part is (0-255).

fields.name: band_width
fields.label: Band Width
fields.help: How thick the bar is.

fields.name: rounded
fields.label: Rounded Caps
fields.help: Round the bar's ends.

fields.name: fade_fill
fields.label: Fade Fill
fields.help: Fade the colour from dim to bright along the filled part, for a glowing look.

fields.name: lead_edge_enabled
fields.label: Leading Edge
fields.help: Add a bright tip at the current reading, like a glowing bar end.

fields.name: lead_edge_color
fields.label: Leading Edge Color
fields.help: Colour of that bright tip.

fields.name: lead_edge_width
fields.label: Leading Edge Width
fields.help: How wide the bright tip is.

fields.name: redline_color
fields.label: Redline Color
fields.help: Colour of the warning zone.

fields.name: redline_recolor_ticks
fields.label: Recolor Ticks Past Redline
fields.help: Turn the marks inside the warning zone that colour too.

fields.name: shape
fields.label: Shape
fields.help: Pick a ready-made shape (straight, L-bend, 45°, or the curved J-hook tacho) sized to fit the box, or Custom to draw your own path. Default matches the firmware factory default (0 = Custom): defaults-only saves omit this field, so a mismatched editor default silently relabels saved custom bars.

fields.name: orientation
fields.label: Orientation
fields.help: Which way the bar runs and fills.

fields.name: corner_radius
fields.label: Corner Radius
fields.help: How big the rounded corner of the bend is (or the bevel, on the 45° shape).

fields.name: hook_angle
fields.label: Hook Sweep
fields.help: J-hook shape only: how far the curve sweeps. 90 is a quarter turn, 180 a half turn.

fields.name: smooth
fields.label: Smooth Curve
fields.help: Custom shapes only: smooth your drawn points into a flowing curve.

fields.name: show_ticks
fields.label: Show Scale
fields._doc:
Draw a tick + number scale that FOLLOWS the path (spaced by
arc-length so the marks line up with the fill). Turns a bare
pathbar into a Ford-style swept tach.
fields.help: Show marks along the bar.

fields.name: major_tick_step
fields.label: Major Tick Value Spacing
fields.help: How far apart the biggest marks are, in reading value.

fields.name: minor_tick_step
fields.label: Minor Tick Value Spacing
fields.help: How far apart the smaller marks are. 0 turns them off.

fields.name: major_tick_width
fields.label: Major Tick Width
fields.help: How thick the biggest marks are.

fields.name: tick_width
fields.label: Minor Tick Width
fields.help: How thick the smaller marks are.

fields.name: major_tick_len
fields.label: Major Tick Length
fields.help: How long the biggest marks are.

fields.name: tick_len
fields.label: Minor Tick Length
fields.help: How long the smaller marks are.

fields.name: major_tick_color
fields.label: Major Tick Color
fields.help: Colour of the biggest marks.

fields.name: tick_color
fields.label: Minor Tick Color
fields.help: Colour of the smaller marks.

fields.name: show_labels
fields.label: Show Numbers
fields.help: Show numbers next to the biggest marks.

fields.name: label_font
fields.label: Number Font
fields.help: Text style and size of those numbers.

fields.name: label_color
fields.label: Number Color
fields.help: Colour of those numbers.

fields.name: label_gap
fields.label: Number Gap
fields.help: How far the numbers sit from the bar.

fields.name: label_side
fields.label: Number Side
fields._doc:
Auto faces the path's inside (good for a smooth curve). On a
sharp/multi-corner path Auto can flip side at the bends — pick
Side A or B to lock every number to one consistent side.
fields.help: Which side of the bar the numbers sit on. Auto picks per number (can flip on sharp paths); Side A/B locks them all to one side.

fields.name: label_along_offset
fields.label: Number Slide
fields._doc:
Shifts every number ALONG the path (by arc-length px), so you
can nudge them off the tick toward the start/end of the bar.
fields.help: Slide the numbers along the bar (negative = toward the start, positive = toward the end).

fields.name: tick_label_divisor
fields.label: Number Divisor
fields._doc:
Divides each number by this factor — e.g. 1000 turns a
0..8000 tach into 0..8 (print the unit elsewhere).
fields.help: Shrink the numbers by dividing them (1000 shows 7000 as '7').

fields.name: smoothing_ms
fields.label: Smoothing (ms)
fields.help: Smooths out jumpy readings. Higher is smoother but slower to react; 0 shows the raw value.
